markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (91%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set and full second-model agreement [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 91%, Invasive 6%, Benign 2% | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | InSitu only (90% level) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 InSitu | Unanimous [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 6, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules** (regions 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; spot check failed (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 4, 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score; spot check 3/20 · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Near-typical score; no elevated invasion signal · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Unreliable here: normal lobules, necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Stain degradation (severity 3) in this simulated frozen section distorts appearance; reliability AUROC is only 0.69.
- Focal invasion in regions 6 or 1 (per-region risk 63%, 38%) is under-weighted in the image score.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 6**: Highest per-region invasive risk (63%); look for stromal invasion versus duct-confined growth.
2. **Regions 1, 3**: Next-highest invasive risks (38%, 19%); confirm no infiltrating stroma.
3. **Regions 8–11**: Inferior edge has the longest suggested tumor-at-margin stretch (323 µm); confirm [F7].
